headword: {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}

definitions.explanation: The chemical compound CO, an odorless and colorless toxic gas produced by incomplete combustion. A common cause of poisoning from poorly ventilated heaters, charcoal grills, and engine exhaust.

examples.japanese: {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}は{有毒|ゆうどく}だ。
{換気|かんき}しないと{一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}{中毒|ちゅうどく}になる{恐|おそ}れがある。
examples.english: Without ventilation, there's a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning.

examples.japanese: {灯油|とうゆ}ストーブを{使|つか}うときは、{一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}が{発生|はっせい}しないよう{定期的|ていきてき}に{換気|かんき}しよう。
examples.english: When using a kerosene heater, ventilate regularly to prevent carbon monoxide from building up.

notes:
Composed of {一酸化|いっさんか} (mono-oxide) + {炭素|たんそ} (carbon). Distinct from {二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ} (CO₂, carbon dioxide), which is also a combustion product but far less acutely toxic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}{中毒|ちゅうどく}: carbon monoxide poisoning
- {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}が{発生|はっせい}する: carbon monoxide is generated
- {一酸化炭素|いっさんかたんそ}{警報器|けいほうき}: CO detector

USAGE:
- Odorless and colorless — undetectable without an instrument
- Produced by incomplete combustion (poor ventilation, low oxygen)
- Binds to hemoglobin much more strongly than oxygen, so even low concentrations can be fatal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {二酸化炭素|にさんかたんそ}: carbon dioxide (CO₂) — exhaled by breathing, much less acutely toxic
- {酸素|さんそ}: oxygen (O₂)
